simple.prompt: Listen! The lead vocalist ___ a brand-new song on stage right now.
simple.explanation: Penanda waktu 'right now' dan seruan 'Listen!' menandakan aksi sedang berlangsung saat ini. Subjek tunggal 'The lead vocalist' berpasangan dengan 'is singing'.

simple.prompt: The developers ___ the final deployment to the production server at the moment.
simple.explanation: 'The developers' adalah subjek jamak (they), sehingga rumus Present Continuous memakai 'are' + verb-ing: 'are preparing'.

simple.prompt: Susun kalimat Present Continuous tentang kegiatan yang sedang berlangsung.
simple.targetSentence: We are testing the new application right now.
simple.explanation: Subject (We) + are + Verb-ing (testing) + Object (the new application) + Time (right now).

simple.prompt: Look at the ejaan: The team is ___ a new contract with the supplier.
simple.explanation: Kata kerja 1 suku kata dengan pola konsonan-vokal-konsonan (p-l-a-n) menggandakan konsonan akhir sebelum -ing: planning.

simple.targetSentence: He is not working at the office today.
simple.explanation: Pola negatif: Subject (He) + is + not + verb-ing (working) + place (at the office) + time (today).

simple.prompt: Why ___ you wearing a formal suit today? Is there an executive audit?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan Present Continuous dengan subjek 'you' memakai to be 'are': 'Why are you wearing...?'

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Present Continuous dengan subjek orang ketiga tunggal.
simple.targetSentence: Is she preparing the financial report?
simple.explanation: To be (Is) + Subject (she) + Verb-ing (preparing) + Object (the financial report)?

simple.prompt: Listen! Someone ___ at the main entrance door.
simple.explanation: Penanda langsung 'Listen!' menunjukkan kejadian berlangsung tepat saat berbicara -> Present Continuous ('is knocking').
hints: Kata 'Listen!' menandakan kejadian sekarang ini juga.

simple.prompt: The interns ___ the training binders in the conference room right now.
simple.explanation: Subjek jamak 'The interns' + 'right now' memakai 'are preparing'.

simple.prompt: Look at the spelling: My brother is ___ a letter to the scholarship committee.
simple.explanation: Verb berakhiran konsonan + huruf 'e' bisu ('write') melepas 'e' sebelum ditambah '-ing': 'writing'.

simple.prompt: They ___ working today because the building is undergoing maintenance.
simple.explanation: Subjek 'They' berpasangan dengan bentuk negatif 'are not' / 'aren't' sebelum 'working'.

simple.prompt: Lengkapi dialog singkat tentang aktivitas yang sedang berlangsung saat ini.
dialogue: Raka
Where is Dini? I can't see her at her desk.
Siti
She ___ a phone call with a vendor in Booth 2.
simple.explanation: Menjawab posisi dan kegiatan yang sedang dilakukan sekarang memakai 'is making'.
hints: Kegiatan sedang berlangsung saat Dini dicari.

simple.prompt: Is it still ___ outside, or can we walk to the café now?
simple.explanation: Dalam pertanyaan Present Continuous setelah 'Is it', main verb harus berbentuk '-ing': 'raining'.
hints: Sudah ada to be 'Is' di depan.

simple.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan ejaan akhiran '-ing' pada kalimat berikut.
simple.draft: The chef is cuting fresh herbs while the pasta is boil.
options: The chef is cutting fresh herbs while the pasta is boiling.
The chef is cutting fresh herbs while the pasta is boil.
The chef is cuting fresh herbs while the pasta is boiling.
simple.explanation: 'Cut' (pola CVC 1 suku kata) menggandakan konsonan akhir menjadi 'cutting'; 'boil' setelah 'is' menjadi 'boiling'.

simple.prompt: I ___ reading a fascinating biography about architectural pioneers.
Susun kalimat Present Continuous tentang hal yang terjadi sekarang.
simple.targetSentence: The technicians are testing the backup generator right now.
simple.explanation: Subject (The technicians) + are + testing + object + right now.
hints: Awali dengan subjek jamak 'The technicians are'.

simple.prompt: Susun pertanyaan Yes/No dalam Present Continuous.
simple.targetSentence: Are you waiting for the afternoon shuttle?
simple.explanation: Pertanyaan membalik to be 'Are' ke depan subjek 'you' + waiting...

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi dialog di kantor mengenai situasi sementara (temporary situation).
dialogue: Colleague
Where is Brenda working this week?
Staff
Her department is being renovated, so she ___ from home this week.
intermediate.explanation: Present Continuous digunakan untuk situasi sementara (temporary situation) dengan keterangan waktu seperti 'this week' atau 'these days'.
hints: Situasi ini bersifat sementara selama minggu ini saja.
Gunakan Present Continuous untuk situasi sementara.

intermediate.prompt: We usually meet at the main office, but this month we ___ online conferences.
intermediate.explanation: 'This month' menunjukkan perubahan rutinitas yang bersifat sementara, sehingga memakai Present Continuous 'are conducting'.
hints: Bandingkan kebiasaan umum (usually) dengan variasi sementara bulan ini.
Situasi khusus bulan ini memakai Present Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Global temperatures ___ steadily due to climate change.
intermediate.explanation: Present Continuous digunakan untuk tren perubahan yang sedang berlangsung perlahan (trends/gradual change): 'are rising'.
hints: Menggambarkan tren kenaikan yang sedang terjadi bertahap.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat yang menyatakan rencana pasti di masa depan (fixed future arrangement).
intermediate.targetSentence: We are meeting the client tomorrow afternoon.
intermediate.explanation: Present Continuous sering digunakan untuk rencana perjanjian masa depan yang sudah terkonfirmasi (future arrangement).
hints: Gunakan 'are meeting' dengan keterangan waktu 'tomorrow afternoon'.

intermediate.prompt: Perhatikan kata kerja ejaan: The children are ___ their shoes before entering the temple.
intermediate.explanation: Kata kerja berakhiran -ie (seperti tie, die, lie) mengubah -ie menjadi 'y' sebelum ditambah -ing: tie $\rightarrow$ tying, lie $\rightarrow$ lying.

intermediate.targetSentence: Electric vehicles are becoming more affordable.
intermediate.explanation: Subject: Electric vehicles + are + becoming (sedang menjadi) + more affordable.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang jadwal perjalanan bisnis terencana.
dialogue: Manager
What is your flight schedule for the Singapore summit?
Executive
I ___ next Tuesday on the 8 a.m. flight.
intermediate.explanation: Penerbangan yang tiketnya sudah dipesan dan terencana pasti menggunakan Present Continuous: 'I am flying next Tuesday'.
hints: Rencana pasti masa depan yang sudah dijadwalkan.

intermediate.prompt: My cousin ___ at our aunt's house for two weeks while his apartment is repainted.
intermediate.explanation: Situasi sementara berdurasi terbatas ('for two weeks while...') memakai Present Continuous ('is staying').

intermediate.prompt: Electric vehicles ___ increasingly common in metropolitan areas these days.
intermediate.explanation: Tren atau perubahan bertahap yang sedang berlangsung di masa kini ('these days') memakai Present Continuous ('are becoming').
hints: Menggambarkan tren perubahan yang sedang terjadi.

intermediate.prompt: Lengkapi percakapan tentang rencana pasti di waktu dekat (fixed arrangement).
dialogue: Colleague
Are you free for lunch this Thursday?
Manager
Sorry, I ___ our Tokyo supplier at twelve sharp. The table is booked.
intermediate.explanation: Untuk janji temu atau jadwal pribadi yang sudah pasti dipesan waktunya, gunakan Present Continuous ('am meeting').

intermediate.prompt: Look at the spelling rule for verbs ending in '-ie': 'The old battery is ___ rapidly.'
intermediate.explanation: Verb berakhiran '-ie' ('die', 'lie', 'tie') mengubah '-ie' menjadi '-y' sebelum ditambah '-ing': 'dying'.

intermediate.prompt: Who ___ helping the new receptionist set up the badge printer?
intermediate.explanation: Subject question dengan kata tanya 'Who' dianggap tunggal sehingga menggunakan auxiliary 'is' ('Who is helping...?').

intermediate.prompt: Koreksi kesalahan penulisan Present Continuous dengan kata kerja berakhiran 'y'.
intermediate.draft: The interns are studing the user manual while the mentor is replyng to tickets.
options: The interns are studying the user manual while the mentor is replying to tickets.
The interns are studing the user manual while the mentor is replying to tickets.
The interns are studying the user manual while the mentor is replyng to tickets.
intermediate.explanation: Akhiran '-y' TIDAK pernah dihilangkan saat membentuk '-ing': 'study → studying', 'reply → replying'.

intermediate.prompt: Why ___ she packing her suitcase today? Is she flying out early?
intermediate.explanation: Terdapat participle '-ing' ('packing'), sehingga auxiliary pertanyaannya wajib to be 'is', bukan 'does'.

intermediate.prompt: Fuel costs ___ steadily this quarter, squeezing small delivery businesses.
intermediate.explanation: Perubahan bertahap yang sedang berkembang ('steadily this quarter') memakai Present Continuous jamak: 'are rising'.
hints: Menunjukkan tren kenaikan yang sedang terjadi.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat rencana pasti untuk akhir pekan ini.
intermediate.targetSentence: We are hosting an open-house workshop this Saturday.
intermediate.explanation: Fixed arrangement dengan waktu spesifik ('this Saturday') memakai Present Continuous.

intermediate.prompt: Susun kalimat tentang kondisi kerja sementara.
intermediate.targetSentence: She is covering the helpdesk shift this week.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan penggunaan stative verb (kata kerja keadaan/emosi) dalam bentuk continuous.
complex.draft: I am understanding the complex algorithms now.
options: I understand the complex algorithms now.
I am understood the complex algorithms now.
I have understanding the complex algorithms now.
complex.explanation: 'Understand' adalah stative verb (kata kerja kognisi/pikiran) yang umumnya TIDAK digunakan dalam bentuk continuous (-ing), melainkan Present Simple: 'I understand'.
hints: 'Understand' menyatakan kondisi mental/pemikiran, bukan aksi fisik.
Stative verbs tidak lazim menggunakan bentuk -ing.

complex.prompt: Perhatikan perbedaan makna: 'The chef ___ the soup to check if it needs more salt.'
complex.explanation: Ketika 'taste' bermakna tindakan aktif mencicipi (action verb), ia BISA berbentuk continuous: 'is tasting the soup'. Sebaliknya jika menyatakan rasa ('The soup tastes good'), ia bersifat stative.
hints: Koki melakukan aksi fisik mencicipi rasa kuah.
Sebagai kata kerja aksi aktif, 'taste' dapat memakai -ing.

complex.explanation: Di sini 'taste' menyatakan kualitas/rasa dari pasta (stative linking verb), sehingga harus berbentuk Present Simple tunggal: 'tastes'.
hints: Pasta tidak melakukan aksi; ini adalah rasa makanannya.
Stative linking verb memakai Present Simple.

complex.prompt: Koreksi kalimat berikut yang menyatakan kejengkelan terhadap kebiasaan berulang menggunakan 'always'.
complex.draft: He always loses his keys, which is so annoying!
options: He is always losing his keys, which is so annoying!
He always is losing his keys, which is so annoying!
He always lost his keys, which is so annoying!
complex.explanation: Pola 'Subject + is/are + ALWAYS + verb-ing' digunakan secara khusus untuk mengekspresikan kekesalan/kejengkelan terhadap kebiasaan buruk yang terlalu sering terulang.
hints: Kekesalan terhadap kebiasaan menyebalkan menggunakan continuous + always.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat dengan stative verb 'have' vs dynamic 'having'.
complex.targetSentence: They are having an urgent meeting now.
complex.explanation: Frasa 'have a meeting/have lunch' adalah aktivitas dinamis, sehingga sah menggunakan continuous: 'are having an urgent meeting'.
hints: 'Having a meeting' adalah idiom aktivitas, bukan kepemilikan benda.

complex.prompt: Why is the baby crying? She ___ tired and hungry.
complex.explanation: 'Look' bermakna tampak/kelihatan (linking verb) adalah stative verb yang memakai Present Simple: 'She looks tired'.
hints: Gunakan bentuk Present Simple untuk linking verb.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog yang membedakan 'see' sebagai penglihatan vs 'see' sebagai janji temu/kunjungan.
dialogue: Colleague
Are you free at 3 p.m. this afternoon?
Doctor
No, I ___ a new patient at that time.
complex.explanation: Ketika 'see' bermakna berkonsultasi, mengunjungi, atau menemui seseorang (meeting/dating), ia berfungsi dinamis dan memakai continuous: 'am seeing a patient'.
hints: 'See' di sini bermakna mengadakan janji temu dengan pasien.

complex.prompt: Pilih kalimat yang BENAR menggunakan makna dinamis (sementara/perilaku) dari stative verb 'be'.
options: My usually patient mentor is being unusually strict with deadlines this week.
My usually patient mentor is unusually being strict with deadlines this week.
My usually patient mentor be unusually strict with deadlines this week.
complex.explanation: 'Is being + adjective' digunakan khusus untuk menggambarkan perilaku sementara yang tidak biasa pada saat ini ('bertingkah tegas minggu ini').
hints: Pola 'is being + adjective' menyatakan sikap sementara, bukan sifat permanen.

complex.prompt: Perhatikan nuansa kritik: 'Why ___ the printer ___ out of paper just before every board meeting?!'
complex.explanation: Present Continuous + 'always' (atau 'constantly') mengekspresikan keluhan atau kejengkelan terhadap kejadian yang berulang terus.
hints: Pola 'is + always + V-ing' menyatakan rasa jengkel.

complex.prompt: Sunting kesalahan penggunaan stative verb kepemilikan dan keinginan pada kalimat berikut.
complex.draft: I am wanting a faster laptop because I am having trouble compiling large builds right now.
options: I want a faster laptop because I am having trouble compiling large builds right now.
I want a faster laptop because I have trouble compiling large builds right now always.
I am wanting a faster laptop because I have trouble compiling large builds right now.
complex.explanation: 'Want' adalah stative verb (pakai 'I want'), sedangkan 'having trouble' bermakna mengalami kesulitan aktif sekarang sehingga 'am having trouble' benar.
hints: 'Have trouble' bermakna mengalami situasi aktif sehingga boleh continuous.

complex.prompt: Lengkapi dialog perbedaan makna kata kerja 'think' sebagai opini vs proses mental.
dialogue: Colleague
What do you think about the revised onboarding flow?
Manager
I ___ it looks promising, though I ___ of simplifying step three.
complex.explanation: 'Think' untuk menyatakan pendapat ('I think it looks...') adalah stative (Present Simple), sementara 'thinking of' bermakna sedang menimbang rencana ('am thinking').
hints: Klausa kedua menyatakan proses mempertimbangkan ide.

complex.prompt: Look at the subtle contrast: 'The doctor ___ three patients before lunch' vs 'I ___ a blurry spot in the scan.'
complex.explanation: 'Seeing patients' bermakna aksi konsultasi/janji temu (bisa continuous); 'see a blurry spot' bermakna persepsi indra penglihatan (stative: 'see').
hints: 'See' = melihat melalui indra mata memakai Present Simple.

complex.prompt: Manakah kalimat yang secara tepat menggambarkan adegan latar sedang berlangsung saat pembaca masuk ke cerita (narrative immediacy)?
options: The analyst sits down, checks the monitor, and notices that the dashboard is flashing red.
The analyst is sitting down, checks the monitor, and notice that the dashboard flash red.
The analyst sitting down, checking the monitor, and noticing that the dashboard is flash red.
complex.explanation: Dalam narasi langsung yang efektif, urutan aksi singkat memakai Present Simple ('sits', 'checks', 'notices') dan latar belakang yang terus berkedip memakai Present Continuous ('is flashing').
hints: Aksi cepat berurutan memakai Present Simple.
Keadaan latar yang berlangsung terus memakai Present Continuous.

complex.prompt: Perbaiki kesalahan perpaduan dua tense dan ejaan pada kalimat berita bisnis ini.
complex.draft: More and more consumers are prefering local brands as prices are skyrocketting.
options: More and more consumers prefer local brands as prices are skyrocketing.
More and more consumers are preferring local brands as prices skyrocketing.
More and more consumers prefering local brands as prices are skyrocketing.
complex.explanation: 'Prefer' umumnya stative verb preferensi ('prefer', dan kalaupun ber-ing ejaannya 'preferring'); 'skyrocket' berakhiran V-V-C dengan suku kata akhir tak ditekan menjadi 'skyrocketing'.

complex.prompt: Just when we think the audit is finished, the regulator ___ always requesting additional appendices.
complex.explanation: Untuk mengungkapkan keluhan berulang dengan 'always + V-ing', subjek tunggal 'the regulator' memakai 'is'.
hints: Keluhan berulang memakai pola 'be + always + V-ing'.

complex.targetSentence: Our upstairs neighbor is constantly moving heavy furniture at midnight.
complex.explanation: Pola 'is constantly + V-ing' menyampaikan rasa terganggu atas kebiasaan berulang.
hints: Awali dengan 'Our upstairs neighbor is constantly'.

complex.prompt: Susun kalimat yang membedakan sifat tetap dan perilaku sementara.
complex.targetSentence: He is normally shy, but today he is being surprisingly talkative.
complex.explanation: 'Is being + adjective' menekankan perilaku sementara pada hari ini saja.
hints: Gunakan 'but today he is being surprisingly talkative'.
